# Implementation Plan: Document Upload and Management

**Branch**: `main` | **Date**: 2026-06-15 | **Spec**: specs/001-document-upload-management/spec.md
**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-document-upload-management/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.plan`. Related artifacts created: `research.md`, `data-model.md`, `quickstart.md` in this feature folder.

## Summary

Add secure document upload, browsing, sharing, and management to the ContosoDashboard
Blazor application. Files are stored outside `wwwroot` using an abstraction
(`IFileStorageService`) with a local implementation for training. Uploads use an
asynchronous quarantine scan workflow before files become available.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C# / .NET 8 (target net8.0, net10.0 compatible)  
**Primary Dependencies**: ASP.NET Core, Blazor Server, Entity Framework Core, xUnit, bUnit  
**Storage**: Local filesystem for training (configurable via `IFileStorageService`), database via existing EF Core DbContext  
**Testing**: xUnit for unit tests, bUnit for Blazor component testing, integration tests via TestServer/WebApplicationFactory  
**Target Platform**: Blazor Server app running on Windows (Local dev) and Linux hosts in production  
**Project Type**: Web application (single project: `ContosoDashboard`)  
**Performance Goals**: Upload completes ≤30s for 25 MB files; list/search pages ≤2s for up to 500 documents  
**Constraints**: Offline/local storage required for training; File size limit 25 MB; MIME field supports 255 chars  
**Scale/Scope**: Training-sized dataset (hundreds to low thousands of documents); design supports cloud migration
